title: Understanding Granularity
text: Granularity refers to the level of detail represented by each row in a dataset. Consider what each row in the table represents in terms of the data provided.

title: Identifying the Key Element
text: Look at the columns: $$post_{id}$$, date, likes, and $$day_{of,week}$$. What do these columns collectively describe?
choices: Each row represents one day of the week.
Each row represents one number of likes.
Each row represents one month of posts.
